mapper.select: SELECT quoted_at, event_id FROM strategy_quotes WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY quoted_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_quotes (symbol, quoted_at, price, event_id) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{quotedAt}, #{price}, #{eventId, typeHandler=com.team5.notifications.mapper.UuidTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (symbol, quoted_at) DO NOTHING
